description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BaseEncounterVisitHandler' that implements the 'EncounterVisitHandler' interface, providing a default implementation for the 'getDisplayName()' method which delegates to a localized version using the current context's locale.

classes.name: BaseEncounterVisitHandler
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a base implementation for encounter visit handlers, providing default behavior for retrieving display name.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a localized display name for the handler by delegating to the method with locale parameter, defaulting to the current context's locale.
